endorsements.quote: FMEA is a structured, team-based methodology designed to identify potential failure modes within complex processes and prioritise mitigation strategies.
Therefore, maintaining human oversight and multidisciplinary governance is essential.

unlisted_practices: Ensure interoperability between digital pathology platforms, laboratory information systems, and enterprise health data ecosystems when deploying AI.
Integrate agentic AI with FMEA so that continuous AI performance data iteratively recalibrates FMEA risk scoring.
Deploy AI applications selectively to address high-RPN failure modes in laboratory workflows.

screen.reason: The paper uses survey and FMEA data to propose a conceptual framework and governance approach for integrating agentic AI into pathology risk management; it does not empirically evaluate an AI deployment.
